note:
R51 — Arena venue-parameter inventory (Phase 2.5 "venue parameters beyond identity — not inventoried in Studio terms"): every field of the
arena table (`exhibitionarena` on gen7 / PS4; `stockarenatable` or the arena-named table on gen6 if present) on all 27 anchors, read-only.

Per anchor: rows; per field: the metadata name, distinct value count, min / max, the dominant value and its share, whether the field is
constant, whether it looks like a reference (its non-zero values all fall inside another table's index range — tested against
`exhibitionteams.index`, `exhibitionarena.index`, `stockleagues.leagueid`), and a class guess (identity / text / count / id / flag / audio /
horn-builder / lighting / seating / unknown) from the name. Nothing here is a consumer trace; the classes are name-based candidates.
Usage: python r51_arena_venue_field_inventory.py <out.json>
